SELECT ip.ip_id AS ipId, ip.subnet AS subnet, ip.ip AS ip
FROM ${ipPoolName} ip
WHERE ip.is_deleted = 0 and ip.ip like CONCAT('%',#{ip},'%') and ip.ip_level =#{ipLevel} and ip.is_used =#{isUsed} and ip.subnet =#{subnet} and ip.org_no=#{orgNo} and ip.ip like CONCAT('%',#{ippoolSegment},'%') order by ip.order_no*1 asc

SELECT stip.ip as ip, stip.ip_level as ipLevel, stip.is_used as isUsed, cts.vlan_id as vlanId, cts.subnet_name as subnetName, ssp.nas_ip as nasip, ctua.mac_address AS appMac, ctua.device_code AS deviceCode, ctua.device_type_name AS basicDeviceType, ctua.mi_user AS miUser, ctua.is802 as is802
FROM ${ipPoolName} stip LEFT JOIN idevelop_safeaccess_subnet cts ON stip.subnet = cts.id and cts.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN idevelop_safeaccess_user_access ctua on stip.ip = ctua.ip_address and ctua.is_deleted = 0 AND cts.id = ctua.subnet_id left join sdn_switch_port ssp on ssp.user_name = ctua.approveu_user
WHERE stip.ip_id =#{ippoolId} group by ip

select sw_firm as swFirm, sw_model as swModel, sw_ip as swIp, ports_count as porstCount from idevelop_safeaccess_subnet cts LEFT JOIN idevelop_safeaccess_switche ctsw ON ctsw.id = cts.switchboard and ctsw.is_deleted = 0 where cts.id = #{subnetId} and cts.is_deleted = 0
select a.nas_port from sdn_switch_port a where a.framed_ip_address = #{ipAddress} ORDER BY a.access_start_time desc limit 1
select count(sh3cdi.device_id) as num from sdn_h3c_device_interface sh3cdi left join sdn_h3c_rs_device sh3crd on sh3crd.id = sh3cdi.device_id where sh3crd.ip_address = #{authIp}
